hil_metrics.HIL-Level: highest standardized harness generation satisfying its declared gate and retention tests
hil_metrics.HIL-AUC: normalized area under HLIS versus harness-generation curve
hil_metrics.HIL-Ceiling: maximum HLIS across standardized harness generations

zero_policy: Omit genuinely N/A dimensions (e.g. O for singleton). Do not convert N/A to zero. A true required zero may invalidate strict geometric score.
confidence_interval: Report bootstrap or other predeclared uncertainty interval when sample size permits.
notes: Weights and aggregate formulas are provisional until empirically calibrated. Always report the full profile with the scalar.

net_of_false_completion.rho_source: the task's own loss terms; p_star = rho/(1+rho)
net_of_false_completion.why: A_DI in v0.1 is the weighted mean of P(success), so two harness generations that differ only in whether wrong work is returned as done receive the SAME score. Measured: HG0 and HG1 produced an identical pass pattern and differed entirely in false completions. A curve computed from P(success) alone cannot see its own first rung.

rho_V.definition: over runs rejected at attempt k, the fraction accepted at k+1 with no help deeper than CID1
rho_V.why: Harness Gain is a difference of two scores and cannot say which mechanism produced it. Acceptance and reversibility raise the score without the model doing anything; retry and routing require the model to convert a detected failure into a correction.
